name: East Haddonfield
imageAlt: Phelps Garage at night in East Haddonfield, an official Halloween: The Game screenshot
summary: Halloween: The Game map featuring the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage, with randomized objectives and escape opportunities each match.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: The official September 1 map announcement places the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage in East Haddonfield.

sections.title: Gameplay Notes
sections.body: Use the Rabbit in Red Lounge and Phelps Garage as orientation landmarks. Objectives, required items, and available escapes can vary between matches, so this page does not present one fixed route as universal.

name: Tower Farm
imageAlt: Neutral site placeholder; no approved official Tower Farm image is available
summary: Free Halloween: The Game post-launch map arriving October 27, 2026, inspired by Halloween 5 settings, with country roads, cornfields, farmhouses, barns, a trailer park and a harvest festival.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: The official October 5, 2026 content update announcement adds Tower Farm as a free multiplayer map scheduled for October 27, 2026. It is map 5 and takes inspiration from Halloween 5 settings. Confirmed elements include rural country roads, a filling station, cornfields, roadside ditches, farmhouses, farm equipment, hay bales, brush, barns and sheds, a harvest festival, a trailer park, and pumpkin gardens. No official gameplay statistics accompany the announcement.

sections.title: Gameplay Notes
sections.body: The announcement describes open rural areas with exposed crossings and longer sightlines than the launch neighborhoods. Spawn behavior, escape routes, objective placement, dimensions, and tested balance are not established before release, so this page makes no claims about them. Check the October 27 update overview for release status.
